ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent framework that continuously monitors cloud resources, detects misconfigurations, and automatically opens pull requests with verified security fixes.

ideas.title: Agentic Compliance Auditor for Cloud Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Agentic AI track and mimics the autonomous repair pattern seen in winning agent projects like blackbox-datahub, focusing on real engineering output rather than chat wrappers.

ideas.title: OpenInnovate Civic Incident Triaging Platform
